description: Fruit and Tree Nuts Data is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The series combines fruit and tree-nut production, prices, trade and consumption statistics. Its stated coverage is United States with selected global comparisons; monthly and annual tables. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The component tables have different source agencies and update schedules. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
